candidate.title: Fixed an issue where some installation status lines were not finalized correctly which can cause odd rendering when terminal windows are resized

evidence.excerpt:
- |
    **Fixed** an issue where some installation status lines were not finalized correctly which can cause odd rendering when terminal windows are resized.

issue: istioctl install output is wrongly spaced [closed; labels area/environments]
```$ istioctl install --set profile=ambient --skip-confirmation
|\
| \
| \
| \
/|| \
/ || \
/ || \
/ || \
/ || \
/ || \
/______||__________\
____________________
\__ _____/
\_____/

✔ Istio core installed ⛵️
✔ Istiod installed 🧠
✔ CNI installed 🪢
✔ Ztunnel installed 🔒
✔ Installation complete Made this installation the default for cluster-wide operations.
The ambient profile has been installed successfully, enjoy Istio without sidecars!
```

Note that there's X spaces between the end of

"Installation complete" and "Made this installation", not a new line. This makes things look really weird when you're resizing your terminal.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2c14be6f-7892-4717-9cf3-884d313c9a02

### Version

```Text
$ istioctl version
client version: 1.23.0-alpha.0
control plane version: 1.23.0-alpha.0
data plane version: 1.22.2 (1 proxies), 1.23.0-alpha.0 (3 proxies)
```
